space.title: 👑 궁중 연회 프리비즈
space.ambient: Gentle ambient life: hundreds of candle flames flicker, the crystal chandeliers sparkle and a few pink rose petals drift slowly through the air
space.continuity: the walls, tall windows, marble columns, red banners, chandeliers, banquet tables, throne dais, flowers, candles, people and lighting

shotMeta.subject: the golden ballroom revealed through the open grand doors, with the prince and the young woman in the pink gown at its center
shotMeta.action: The camera glides in through the tall open doors into the candlelit ballroom. Chandeliers sparkle overhead, rose petals drift down, and the couples in the background sway gently in place in a slow waltz.

shotMeta.subject: the long banquet table dressed in white linen, gold candelabra and tiered dessert stands
shotMeta.action: Candle flames flicker over the banquet table and the crystal glasses glint. Two guests beside the table stand still, quietly watching the dance floor.

shotMeta.subject: the silver-haired prince and the young woman in the pink gown at the center of the dance floor
shotMeta.action: The prince slowly extends his gloved right hand toward the young woman, inviting her to dance. She holds still, one hand on her chest, looking at him with a shy smile.

shotMeta.subject: the prince and the young woman in the pink gown, face to face
shotMeta.action: The young woman gently lifts her hand and rests it in the prince's open palm. They hold each other's gaze while rose petals drift past and the background couples sway in place.

shotMeta.subject: the prince and the young woman hand in hand beneath the chandeliers, with the whole ballroom around them
shotMeta.action: Hand in hand, the two hold their pose as the camera drifts back and up to reveal the glittering chandeliers and the waltzing court. Petals keep falling softly.

scene.desc: A grand royal palace ballroom during an evening court banquet. A long hall with a polished dark marble floor that mirrors the candlelight, cream-and-gold walls, tall arched windows, white marble columns along both sides, crimson banners with gold emblems, and three huge golden crystal chandeliers down the center. Long banquet tables in white linen with gold candelabra and tiered dessert stands line the sides, floor candelabra and pink rose arrangements stand near the doors, and a raised dais with two golden thrones sits at the far end. Noble couples in ball gowns and tailcoats waltz in the background. At the center of the dance floor stand a tall silver-haired prince in a black-and-gold embroidered long coat with a cape, white lace jabot and white gloves, and a young woman with long wavy brown hair and a pink flower hair ornament in an off-shoulder pink ball gown of tiered lace ruffles.
scene.style: Lavish romance-fantasy webnovel illustration look, polished semi-realistic anime style. Warm golden candlelight with soft bloom and sparkling bokeh, glowing crystal highlights, rich gold, crimson and rose-pink palette, drifting pink rose petals, shallow depth of field with the lead couple sharp and the crowd softly blurred. Intricate lace, embroidery and jewelry detail, consistent character designs, costumes and lighting across every shot.
scene.avoid: No extra lead characters, no costume, hair color or face changes between shots, no layout or furniture changes, no objects teleporting, no warped hands or faces, no modern clothing or objects, no daylight, no text, logos or subtitles inside the generated scene.
